title: What is your founder coffee order?
intro: Nobody has ever been talked out of their order. This works out which one you are before you say it.
og_line: Five questions and the drink that gives you away.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

questions.q: It is 6am. Why are you awake?

options.a: I always am. It is the quiet hour
I am not. I am still up from yesterday
Slowly, with something warm, no screens yet
I woke up mid idea and had to write it down
Alarm, gym, then the good coffee

questions.q: Someone books a meeting with no agenda.

options.a: I ask what it is about before accepting
I accept and prepare one for them
I accept. Something interesting usually happens
I move it to the end of the week
I accept it and four others, same day

questions.q: Your to do list right now is:

options.a: Three things, all of them real
Colour coded, and I enjoy that
Six lists across four apps
One list, same one for years
The list is a metaphor at this point
Cut it, say so, move
Post mortem, then version two
I already started the next thing during it
Wait a week. It looks different by then
Fix it live, overnight, personally

questions.q: How does the work day end?

options.a: When the thing is done
At a time I decided in advance
Abruptly, mid sentence
Gently, and I do not check afterwards
It does not so much end as pause

results.name: Black Coffee
results.headline: Let us get it done.
results.body: No decoration, no ceremony, no discussion about the notes. You want the effect and you want it now.
results.cost: You mistake speed for progress about twice a quarter.

results.name: Latte
results.headline: The strategic thinker.
results.body: You want the good version and you will wait the extra four minutes for it. Everything you make gets one more pass than it strictly needs.
results.cost: The extra pass sometimes happens instead of shipping.

results.name: Espresso Shot
results.headline: The chaos agent.
results.body: All of it, immediately, standing up. You are the reason the group chat has 40 unread messages at 11pm.
results.cost: Everyone else needs a recovery day after your good ideas.

results.name: Tea
results.headline: The calm operator.
results.body: You have never once been the loudest person in a meeting and you have also never missed a deadline.
results.cost: People forget to ask your opinion because you never demand they do.

results.name: Energy Drink
results.headline: Founder after midnight.
results.body: It is 1am, the thing is nearly working, and stopping now would be insane. You have had this conversation with yourself before.
results.cost: Tomorrow. Tomorrow is what it costs.
